title: Fixed Ridge Saddle Arrow Weather Vane
description: One original complete fixed roof-ridge weather-vane exterior. A continuous folded two-slope saddle and central shoe support a full vertical spindle, a lower fixed crossed reference arm set with four thick directional tips, and an independently orientated upper arrow carrier with broad finite arrowhead and rear tail vane, annular bearing sleeve/shoulder and top boss. This is not an extracted windpump tail or a cup anemometer: it has no tower, rotor, pump, cups, counter or old imported meshes. Three opaque PBR materials, metre scale and actual XY-envelope centring; minimum saddle-edge Z is an export datum, not a flat ground sole. Host roof omitted. Fixed decorative appearance only: no rotation, wind direction measurement, cardinal alignment, aerodynamic response, lightning protection, roof fixing, load or safety certification claim.
